stories.h: 26th Knesset sworn in; opposition picks Kahana for speaker
stories.s: Israel's new 120-seat parliament takes office Tuesday with no bloc holding a majority. Netanyahu's rivals agreed to back Yashar's Matan Kahana for speaker and give Avigdor Liberman the foreign affairs and defense committee.

stories.h: Eisenkot, Liberman agree to court ultra-Orthodox parties
stories.s: Eisenkot's bloc holds 48 seats, short of the 61 needed. After meeting Monday, he and Liberman reportedly approved outreach to Shas and UTJ, including a softened draft bill, and ruled out relying on Arab parties.

stories.h: Netanyahu reportedly urges Trump daily to resume Iran war
stories.s: The Financial Times reports Netanyahu calls Trump daily pushing for new strikes on Iran. Trump says no new offensive for now, citing progress in Qatar-mediated talks, while keeping the US naval blockade in place.

stories.h: Gaza aid deliveries stall as storms flood tents
stories.s: No aid trucks entered Gaza on Nov. 6-7, and Israel reportedly allows in only a fraction of the tents and mobile homes requested. Storms have flooded about 70,000 tents. Gaza's health ministry says 20 people were killed last week.

stories.h: Israeli troops kill 14-year-old in West Bank raid
stories.s: Soldiers shot dead a 14-year-old in Burqa near Nablus and wounded two other teens. The IDF says troops fired at stone-throwers. ACLED says 2026 is on track to be the worst year for settler violence.
